messages:
ana (Demand Gen): Idea: ship a hands-on webinar format where attendees can run a small benchmark in a sandbox during the session. Goal = higher lead signal + immediate trial activation. Thoughts?
leo (Events Ops): Love it. We need a lightweight onboarding flow so people can join the sandbox without infra headaches. Suggest one-click auth + ephemeral API key.
vik (Benchmarks): We can prepare a tiny repo + notebook that runs a 2-minute micro-benchmark (latency/cost). Keep models smallish to avoid heavy GPU usage.
sam (Growth): This format could be gated  to capture intent (product/infra/exec) and route leads accordingly. Also looks great for retargeting when combined with demo recordings.
maria (Mkt Ops): Two quick asks: 1) three short abstracts for different segments; 2) list of speaker roles and backups. We'll draft registration copy once we pick abstracts.
vik (Benchmarks): Draft abstracts (seed):
- Workshop A (Engineers): "Hands-on Benchmark Lab: Measure & Optimize LLM Inference in 15 Minutes"  Follow along with a reproducible notebook to test batching, KV cache, and a low-cost quantized model.
- Workshop B (Product leads): "Benchmarking for Decisions: How to Read LLM Serving Numbers"  Walkthrough of key metrics, SLOs, and what to track when moving from prototype to production.
- Workshop C (Execs/Buyers): "From Experiment to Predictable Spend: A Quick Benchmark Playbook"  Short, business-focused outcomes and a checklist for committing to reserved capacity.
sam (Growth): Those cover personas. For invites: merge B+C with a CTA to reserve a sandbox slot. Add utm=workshop-lab.
leo (Events Ops): Logistics: target 11am PT / 7pm CET. Capacity: cap at 150 live sandbox slots. We need a waiting list flow. signup-bot: Registration page created: /events/workshop-sandbox (draft).
maria (Mkt Ops): Speaker ops: lead engineer (vik) demo + notebook host, product narrative (maria) + 1 customer for quick quote. Backups: leo, sam.
vik (Benchmarks): Demo plan: 2 runs: "default" vs "optimized". We'll show: tokens/sec, avg latency, token cost. Pre-record fallback clips for network or infra issues.
leo (Events Ops): Rehearsal windows: Thu 9am PT or Fri 2pm PT. Please pick.
maria (Mkt Ops): Draft run-of-show (45min workshop):
- 00:00-00:05 Host intro + goals (ana)
- 00:05-00:20 Bench primer & how to run the notebook (vik)
- 00:20-00:35 Live bench run (vik) + attendees run along (facilitated)
- 00:35-00:40 Customer quote & product implications (maria + customer)
- 00:40-00:45 Next steps + trial credits + lead capture CTA (ana)
sam (Growth): Lead routing: include persona in reg form and append to lead metadata. If attendee completes the sandbox run, mark as MQL. Webhook: events -> SFDC queue. Test mapping required.
vik (Benchmarks): Notebook details: GitHub repo + binder link + a 2-cell quickstart. Code snippet for quickstart:
```
# install
pip install redwood-infer-sdk
# run
python run_micro_benchmark.py --model small-quant --prompt-file example.txt
```
leo (Events Ops): Need a short 60s teaser clip from the notebook run for socials. Can we auto-generate a GIF from the pre-recorded run?
maria (Mkt Ops): We'll also build a post-event nurture: Day 0 thank-you + playbook, Day 3 deep-dive (how to reproduce), Day 14 trial nudge with credits. Also tag registrants who didn't run the notebook for a follow-up nurture.
signup-bot: Reminder: sandbox provisioning limit = 150. Current draft capacity reserved: 150 slots.
nana (Demand Gen) [typo correction in thread]: *ana above.
sam (Growth): A/B test subjects: "Hands-on Benchmark Lab: Run your first LLM serving test" vs "Workshop: Reduce LLM Inference Cost in 15 Minutes". Will run a tiny subject test on 5% seed list.
vik (Benchmarks): Risks: noisy runs from participants could skew demo timing. Plan: have 3 facilitators in the attendee Q&A room to triage infra questions. Also prepare a pre-recorded demo that we can switch to if the live bench goes long.
leo (Events Ops): Action items:
- vik: finalize notebook + pre-recorded run (due Tue)
- ana: build reg page + persona fields (due Tue)
- maria: assemble nurture flow + copy (due Wed)
- sam: setup lead routing + SFDC test (due Thu)
- leo: create rehearsal invites + media assets (due Wed)
- customer success: confirm 1 customer quote (due Wed)
maria (Mkt Ops): If no objections, lock format and abstracts by EOD. I'm confident this will give us stronger intent signals. :rocket:
